title: Cost vs Performance
subtitle: Buy the performance your requirement names, and scale the bill with the load
motto: Performance is expensive, so buy what you need and not what sounds impressive
keyInsight: Impressive infrastructure for 50 users cost 57 times the right-sized bill for latency nobody could notice, so size to a stated target and add capacity as measured load arrives.

decisions.title: Reproduce the vault's two bills
decisions.description: The sim's prices are set so the gold-plated design costs $45,000 and the right-sized one about $800, so the frames match the note's story.
decisions.alternatives: Invented prices that gave different totals would leave the story unchecked.

decisions.title: Tie extra performance to a target
decisions.description: The last frame says a second region is justified only when the single region misses the latency target, so spending has a trigger.
decisions.alternatives: A blanket rule such as 'always use several regions' would repeat the gold-plating mistake.
